Conclusions
Undernutrition and micronutrient deﬁciency remain a major cause of morbidity and mortality in children between 1 and 5 years of
age, while the number of children with excess weight continues to rise. These nutrition issues have been directly and indirectly exac-
erbated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Focusing efforts on improving child health, and supporting adequate dietary and nutrient
intake, particularly in this age group, remains a priority.
